prior_access: Existing MIT invented examples/evaluation cases were created 2026-09-13 and exercised in tests. Codex read both before this protocol. Neither is unseen, independently curated, or a real ClinVar observation. No case or prompt was modified for this experiment.

cases.scope: invented Pathogenic classification; one carried allele, unknown classification type, inheritance not curated, no gnomAD/GWAS/PGx evidence
invented Uncertain significance classification; one carried allele, unknown classification type, inheritance not curated, no gnomAD/GWAS/PGx evidence

models.name: llama3.1:8b
models.selection: Installed Allelio default; non-thinking instruction model. Selected before any model output inspection.
models.declared_parameters: stop tokens only; sampling values and seed not declared in /api/show

models.selection: Downloaded smaller alternative with thinking capability; fits this host sequentially. Selected before any model output inspection. No explicit think override; record actual reasoning removal.

generation.sampling: No request temperature, seed, top_k, top_p or think override. /api/show declared defaults retained separately; effective server sampling/context values are not independently verified. No warmup; fixed sequential model/case/repetition order.

order: template second pass for exact text repeatability; not additional cases
Llama 3.1 8B, cases in bundle order, repetitions 1-3 each
Qwen3 4B, cases in bundle order, repetitions 1-3 each

automated_checks.template: Two of two output opportunities: exact production formatter text and presence of rsID, genotype, not-curated inheritance, condition/classification and consultation line. Two repeatability comparisons. Socket connect and DNS denied only inside the baseline process.
automated_checks.models: Twelve model-call opportunities in two case clusters: status, error, actual prompt hashes, text hashes, lexical flag categories, production safety/disclaimer wrapping consistency, reasoning removal count, server stop reason and timing. Model-arm fallbacks remain failures and are excluded from generated-output observations.
automated_checks.denominators: Two distinct cases. Six calls per model = two cases x three repetitions. Fourteen primary output opportunities including two templates. Baseline repeat and model-run template regeneration are integrity checks, not extra evaluation cases. No independent observation assumption, pooled quality score, intervals, sensitivity, or significance test.

qualitative_criteria.factual_support: Inspect claims against the supplied invented evidence; note invented gene biology, citations or unsupported causal/personal risk inferences. No external clinical truth assessment.
qualitative_criteria.unsupported_certainty: Look for diagnoses, penetrance or medication instructions exceeding the evidence. Lexical flags alone do not measure this.
qualitative_criteria.material_omissions: Inspect classification/type uncertainty, unknown inheritance and absent frequency evidence. Record missing context without assigning invented human scores.
qualitative_criteria.uncertainty_communication: Inspect whether evidence uncertainty and source limitations are stated coherently.
qualitative_criteria.readability: Describe organization and jargon as an attributed Codex observation; no human comprehension metric.

inspection_attribution: Codex conducts internal AI-assisted qualitative inspection after freezing outputs. No human ratings, human inspection, independent review or adjudication is implied. Ratings templates remain untouched.
retention: Use a fresh local directory outside Git with preserved inputs, protocol, private-run, receipts, stripped answers, errors, hashes and model metadata. No reasoning content is retained. Keep any failed attempt; never tune or silently replace this protocol in response to its results.

source_artifact_register.artifact: Invented cases, frozen origin manifests, Allelio prompts/template and runner
source_artifact_register.public_handling: Existing synthetic inputs remain public. Publish reviewed protocol, runner, tests, aggregate counts, hashes and observations. Invented rsID-like syntax labels do not assert real variant identities; no participant data.

source_artifact_register.artifact: Model weights, runtime templates and licenses
source_artifact_register.source: Ollama local model registry; exact advertised manifest digests above
source_artifact_register.public_handling: Acquire upstream under each model license; weights/templates/license payloads stay local. MIT code license does not relicense these materials. No model redistribution or fine-tuning.

source_artifact_register.artifact: Synthetic model answers, requests, timing/error receipts and masked rating scaffolds
source_artifact_register.source: This internal experiment; Llama and Qwen model outputs
source_artifact_register.public_handling: Full originals stay local; publish separately reviewed aggregate/hash records and paraphrased observations only. Do not label generated answers as MIT source records or human assessments. No participant linkage; inspect generated names, citations, local paths, credentials and metadata before publication.

limitations: Two previously available invented records are a pilot, not representative genetic evidence or a held-out test.
No curated inheritance, verified frequency, GWAS, PGx, high-impact warning, conflict or multi-record strata are exercised.
A generated status, correct wrapping or absence of lexical flags does not establish factual accuracy, safety or comprehension.
Template has a narrower information-only remit than the model prompt; differences are descriptive.
Adapters constrain prompt endpoints to loopback but a model server is trusted software. This is not OS-level network isolation or a complete privacy/security audit.
Sampling settings and stochastic generation are not fully controlled. Bitwise model regeneration is not promised. Hashes identify retained outputs.
Case reuse and any discovered deficiencies must remain disclosed; future fixes require a distinct protocol/run and do not replace these results.
